0.note: Keith Brooks campaign biography: As a limited-government conservative, Rep. Brooks is proud to be strongly pro-life.

Junelle Cavero campaign priorities: Support statutory and constitutional protections for reproductive freedom, including coverage of abortion services for those who depend on the government for their healthcare.
Adrian Plank campaign values: I firmly believe that everyone deserves access to abortion. Everyone has a right to make their own decisions on whether or not to have children.

2.note: Brian Stewart campaign issues: He co-sponsored the SAFE Act (HB68) to bar biological males from competing in female sports and to prevent minors from undergoing permanent sex-change operations.
Jamie Allard campaign home lists Fighting — Girls' Sports (HB 40) among her current fights as Alaska state representative. HB 40 designates school sports by sex.
